gates.validation_retention: Frozen candidate must already pass the trainer's predeclared strict validation-retention checks
gates.legacy_retention: Matched fresh legacy goal completion >= frozen v1
gates.curriculum_retention: Matched fresh v2-composition goal completion >= frozen v1
gates.legacy_action_cost_retention: Mean declared weighted action cost <= frozen v1 on exactly the same legacy tasks both policies complete
gates.changed_goal_action_retention: Fresh paired changed-goal next-action accuracy >= frozen v2.1
gates.changed_goal_pair_retention: Fresh changed-goal pairs with both members correct >= frozen v2.1
gates.actual_tool_retention: Matched real fixture verified-and-stopped completion >= frozen v2.1
gates.uncertainty_expected: Exact expected verified completion >= each of two cheap baselines
gates.uncertainty_sampled: Matched sampled verified completion >= each of two cheap baselines
gates.useful_efficiency: Strictly lower mean weighted declared action cost plus measured decision overhead on the same episodes both methods complete, against the strongest cheap baseline

protocol.strong_baseline_selection: Highest exact expected verified completion, then sampled completion, then lowest sampled total cost; ties broken by name
protocol.promotion: All gates must pass. No allowed regression tolerance. Failure retains existing defaults.
protocol.timing: Tokens and action latency are declared estimates for belief tasks. Decision latency is measured. Weighted cost = tokens + .01*(declared action ms + measured decision ms). No real tool time is claimed for belief simulation. Model loading and initial warm-up are reported separately and excluded from steady-state decision costs. Method order rotates per problem; one shared-Mac session is not a precision performance benchmark.
protocol.provenance: Fresh instances after freeze; generator families and fixture templates are developer-known. This is not an unseen-repository or natural-language benchmark.
protocol.diagnostic_comparison: Frozen v3 is evaluated on the same fresh v4 cases. It is diagnostic only; beating v3 does not satisfy any gate.
protocol.development_evidence: V3 audit cases and outcomes are known development evidence for v4. They must not be described as blind v4 evaluation.

belief_distribution.holdout: Fresh seeds and instances, with the same developer-known compositional anchors across splits. Not an unseen-family benchmark.
belief_distribution.diagnostics: Per-anchor expected and sampled results, initially verified counts, and exact-planner zero-success-within-five counts reveal mixture easiness. All problems remain in all gates.

protocol.sample_dependence: Four matched stochastic episodes share each problem. The 960 episodes are not 960 independent task draws. Exact expectation integrates declared outcomes; it does not estimate reliability outside the 240 generator instances. No independence-based confidence interval is reported.
protocol.artifact_freeze: Training setup and audit protocol precede training. Frozen selected weights, report and config plus generator, predictor, trainer, evaluator and mechanics source hashes are recorded before final generation; unchanged sources, candidate and baseline artifacts are verified after the audit. One exclusive started marker prevents reruns.
